text: Attention, all crew. This is a drill. Man overboard, starboard side. Man overboard, starboard side.
say: Attention, all crew. This is a drill. Man overboard, starb'd side. Man overboard, starb'd side.
note: ship's loudspeaker: record clean and slow, the app adds the effect

text: Man overboard, starboard side! I see it!
say: Man overboard, starb'd side! I see it!

text: Diego, you will be the lookout. Keep pointing at him and don't look away.
I'll keep pointing. He's there, about two hundred metres, starboard quarter!
say: I'll keep pointing. He's there, about two hundred metres, starb'd quarter!

text: Rolando, you will throw the lifebuoy with the smoke float.
Lifebuoy and smoke float, gone!
Bridge, starboard side. Lookout on the casualty, lifebuoy in the water. Over.
say: Bridge, starb'd side. Lookout on the casualty, lifebuoy in the water. Over.

text: Received. MOB button pressed. I'm turning to starboard. Rescue boat crew, stand by. Over.
say: Received. MOB button pressed. I'm turning to starb'd. Rescue boat crew, stand by. Over.
note: record clean, the app adds the radio

text: I can still see him. Now he's on the starboard beam!
say: I can still see him. Now he's on the starb'd beam!

text: Good, Diego. Keep him in sight. If you lose him, say so at once.
Rescue boat ready. Launching now.
note: record clean, the app adds the radio

text: This is the Captain. Recovery complete. The dummy is on board. The drill is over.
note: ship's loudspeaker: record clean and slow, the app adds the effect

text: Well done, everybody. In real life, the next problem is hypothermia. That's why we're fast.
Where's the man overboard?
Show me the smoke float.
Where's the rescue boat?
Where's the MOB button?
You see someone fall on the left side. Shout!
Diego, you will be the lookout. Keep pointing.
Where is he? Distance?
Diego, can you still see him?
Rolando, you will be in the rescue boat.
He's about three hundred metres, port quarter!
